description: This file defines the SnapshotRenderer class and related utility functions for rendering and processing DOM snapshots in Playwright's trace viewer. It includes methods for rendering HTML, rewriting URLs for custom protocols, and handling canvas and iframe content within snapshots.

classes.name: SnapshotRenderer
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering DOM snapshots into HTML, managing cache, and providing resource and screenshot information within Playwright's trace viewer.

methods.name: findClosest
methods.description: Finds the closest item in a list based on a metric function and target value.

methods.name: isNodeNameAttributesChildNodesSnapshot
methods.description: Type guard to check if a node is a NodeNameAttributesChildNodesSnapshot.

methods.name: isSubtreeReferenceSnapshot
methods.description: Type guard to check if a node is a SubtreeReferenceSnapshot.

methods.name: snapshotNodes
methods.description: Extracts all nodes from a FrameSnapshot, caching the result.

methods.name: snapshotScript
methods.description: Generates a script to apply Playwright-specific attributes and overlays in the snapshot rendering.

methods.name: rewriteURLForCustomProtocol
methods.description: Rewrites URLs with custom protocols to a sanitized form suitable for Electron support.

methods.name: rewriteURLsInStyleSheetForCustomProtocol
methods.description: Rewrites URLs inside stylesheets that use custom protocols.

methods.name: escapeURLsInStyleSheet
methods.description: Encodes URLs inside stylesheets that contain closing tags to prevent HTML parsing issues.
